correctness.rationale: Exact domain: every finite ordinal sum of nonempty antichains, reflexive upward reachability and Boolean modal powerset. Necessity follows from explicit color-respecting bisimulations for identical within-level labels and for the lower copy of an immediate singleton; sufficiency follows by downward suffix-induction using distinct modal characteristic types and a witness from the next level. Independent ordered injective palette choices give the falling factorial product; positivity yields rank. Iterating witness depth yields h-1, attained by identical two-color pairs in each of h levels. The independent finite checker confirms 1,178,754 labeling cases, 504 count comparisons, 640 direct Boolean closures and 14 sharp-depth witnesses. Finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: Finite weak orders are canonical finite S4/Grzegorczyk partial-order frames and finite Alexandrov spaces. The theorem gives an exact all-size and all-height generation classification, all-parameter ordered-tuple counts and a sharp modal depth cutoff. A singleton immediately above a larger antichain forces one extra available label, whereas a nonsingleton next level does not; the phenomenon is absent from complete-cluster-chain formulas. This is a natural full classification, not a narrow recomputation or parameter substitution.
